newsitem.title: USA: Regency Enterprises signs pay-TV deal with TPS.
newsitem.headline: Regency Enterprises signs pay-TV deal with TPS.

text.p: Regency Enterprises, one of the largest independent film producers in the United States, on Wednesday said it granted re-broadcast rights for its films to French pay-TV provider TPS.
Financial details of the agreement were undisclosed.

Regency has produced movies such as the recent Kevin Costner picture, "Tin Cup", and a "A Time to Kill", starring Sandra Bullock. Many of its films are distributed via Time Warner Inc's Warner Bros film studio.
The deal covers films already made and upcoming titles like "Devil's Advocate", starring Al Pacino and Keanu Reeves.

Regency films will be broadcast on the three TPS movie channels, Cinestar 1, Cinestar 2 and Cinetoile, as well as its pay-TV service called Multivision. Through TPS, Multivision currently reaches 450,000 cable households.
